scope: Every 15th recorded frame reads the latest completed render; snapshot sums are not all route frames or all route rays.
performanceUse: Excluded: atomic counters and synchronous GPU readbacks enabled; no timing/FPS representative values are included.

counterSemantics.normal: Per-render reset, 1/64 deterministic screen-pixel mask, function calls from traced pixels; build kernel excluded. query=full+blend+exact. blend also evaluates exact normal.
counterSemantics.farSurface: Per-render reset, all build/consumer invocations in the observed render, no 1/64 mask. First-entry attempts are not all screen pixels. Build and main-ray guard direct density calls exclude implicit calls inside normal and occlusion functions.
counterSemantics.cache: Per-render reset, same 1/64 screen-pixel mask; function calls, not rays. Disabled occlusion query function yields 0, which does not imply no procedural occlusion.
counterSemantics.temporal: Both extension presets have temporal reprojection OFF; 13 zero counters mean disabled, not measured zero-percent reuse.
counterSemantics.builds: Cumulative dispatch counters, not time. Normal increments once per cascade; far surface once per render. Absolute values can include warmup/previous cases. Use first-to-last differences only for the measured interval.
counterSemantics.allocations: targetAllocations counts main cloud render-target allocation events. The JSON has no separate normal/far allocation counters. Stable bytes alone do not prove no cache reallocation.
